methodology: Articles sourced from Virginia-specific RSS feeds and Google News RSS, filtered for AI/technology/workforce relevance, then assessed by Claude against the scenario framework. Each article is tagged with the region it most affects and the scenario it signals toward.

signals.title: Norfolk native brings free AI workshops to Hampton Roads to close the technology gap - WTKR
signals.signal_reading: Free AI workshops targeting technology gap closure in Hampton Roads signal grassroots peer learning and intentional distribution of capability beyond traditional tech hubs, directly challenging concentration dynamics.

signals.title: TAYLOR: AI data centers increase Virginia’s urban-rural divide - The Cavalier Daily
signals.signal_reading: Analysis of AI data centers increasing urban-rural divide reveals infrastructure concentration in NoVA creates economic benefits that fail to distribute, intensifying rather than bridging the capability gap statewide.

signals.title: AI pressure grows on Richmond's young workforce - Axios
signals.signal_reading: AI pressure on Richmond's young workforce suggests platform-driven automation creating widespread shallow exposure without corresponding skill deepening, positioning workers as AI users rather than builders.

signals.title: How Roanoke College’s new pathways tackle the workforce mismatch - University Business
signals.signal_reading: Roanoke College's workforce pathways program addressing skills mismatch through structured training represents institutional investment in distributed capability building outside traditional tech corridors, potentially seeding peer networks.

signals.title: U.Va. pilots three new artificial intelligence literacy courses - The Cavalier Daily
signals.signal_reading: UVA piloting AI literacy courses concentrates deep educational innovation at a flagship research institution, creating excellence that may remain localized unless deliberately designed for statewide knowledge transfer and replication.
